name: Ebara Jitsugyo Co.,Ltd.
summary: Ebara Jitsugyo Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells environmentally related products. The company operates through Manufacturing, Engineering, and Trading business segments. The company offers manufacturing businesses, such as ozone concentration meters, ozone application equipment, industrial deodorizers and deodorizing equipment, energy-saving blowers, water treatment related equipment, infectious disease prevention products, aquaculture related products, and ZEB/ZEH related products.
